verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships a software product (Visalaw AI), so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question here. However, nothing in the evidence documents a public API or a downloadable spec. Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths on visalaw.com all returned 404, and llms.txt also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
